Basic listing–$50

Basic lists your product first under "Other tools to consider" on the page you choose. Card payments are processed by our payment provider; we never see or store card numbers.

How it works

From order to live

  1. Pick a page and a position. In the vendor portal, choose a category shortlist or alternatives page, then a free position on it.
  2. Choose monthly or yearly and pay. Add your product (name and website), accept the advertiser terms and pay by card.
  3. We review your product. It shows as "In editorial review" until we've written its review. Your paid time starts the day it goes live.
Cancelling

Refunds and renewals

Cancel before your product goes live, or if we don't accept it, and you get a full refund. After it goes live, a monthly plan you stop runs to the end of the month you paid for. Details are in the advertiser terms.

A position changes where your product appears on a page. It doesn't change its score or our review. Questions: vendors@vettlo.com.
